newsitem.title: USA: Immunex says FDA approves Leukine liquid.
newsitem.headline: Immunex says FDA approves Leukine liquid.

text.p: Immunex Corp said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved a new liquid, multiple-dose formulation of Leukine, which stimulates the immune system and helps prevent infection in certain cancer patients.
The drug has been available in the U.S. since 1991, in a dehydrated concentrate formulation.

The company said the new formulation is expected to broaden the drug's marketability and consumer appeal. A preservative included in the new formulation insures sterility and allows for multiple doses to be taken with a needle from the same vial.
While the drug currently is not sold for at-home use, Immunex said the new formulation makes that more feasible, and added that the multiple-dosing possibilities reduce waste and cost.
Leukine is given to older adult leukemia patients to treat neutropenia, a depletion of a certain class of white blood cells.
